Remarks:
(1) In the discussion above, wave velocity, thermal diffusivity and diffusion
coefficient are independent on the function investigated (i.e., displacement,
temperature, concentration). Therefore, we assume the wave equation and
the transport equation are linear in the future study.
However, these equations are nonlinear in general.
(2) In the discussion above, vibration, thermal conduction and diffusion are
isolated. However, these phenomena are coupled in general. For instance,
when electromagnetic wave propagates in dielectric materials (e.g., plasmas),
the concentration and temperature distributions become different due to the
propagation of the electromagnetic field.

According to equations of mathematical physics, the state of a system could not
be determined, because the evolution of a system also depends on the “history”
and “environment”, i.e., the initial condition and the boundary condition.
